title: scenario_export_v1
description: RPS scenarios (rows, columns, cells, layers) exchanged between FGCNotepad instances and Sf6ReplaysDb. Mirrors backend/src/Service/ScenarioTransfer/ScenarioImportDocumentValidator.php; see docs/scenario-export.md.

scenarioKey.description: Stable identity. A re-import with the same key updates the scenario. Scenarios created on the site export as source fgcnotepad with their public id.

characterName.description: Character name as listed by FGCNotepad (case and punctuation insensitive).

notation.description: Numpad notation of a move of the given character, e.g. 2MK, 623PP, 236KK > 6HK.

rows.description: Row player options (offense). Keys must be unique within rows; at least one row on layer 1.

columns.description: Column player options (defense). aggregated_oki scenarios must use the fixed defensive catalog columns.

cells.description: Exactly one cell per row x column pair.

triggerMove.description: The move that creates the situation (usually the knockdown). character defaults to the scenario attacker.

position.description: corner/midscreen lock which combos dynamic cells may use; viewer_default_midscreen lets the viewer include corner combos.

knockdownAdvantage.description: Frames of advantage on the knockdown. Informational; nothing computes from it yet.

characterStatuses.description: Character resources fixed for the whole scenario (e.g. Juri Fuha stocks). They filter which combos dynamic cells may use.

object.description: Character resource object key (e.g. juri_fuha) or name.

status.description: Stock count for integer resources, true for boolean ones. Exported as a string.

key.description: Referenced by cells. Exports derive keys from labels.

layer.description: Layer that introduces this option. Layer N is solved with every row/column whose layer is <= N.

requirements.description: The option is only available when every requirement holds (the viewer's resource context).

threshold.description: Meaning: resource >= threshold. Integer for health and super.

summaryValue.description: Probability shown on the axis by the editor; null when unset.

stats.description: Observed stats from the source data: how often this option was picked. Shown as "Seen" on the axis; omit for options without observations.

seenFrequency.description: Share of observed situations where this option was picked (0-1).

sampleCount.description: Number of observed situations the frequency is based on.

starter.description: A dynamic combo starter. The cell value is the best stored combo of the initiator starting with one of these moves under the hit condition, resolved against the viewer's resources.

initiator.description: Which side starts the combo; moves are that character's moves.

reference.description: The cell continues into another scenario (in this document or already stored), which may be this scenario itself or one that links back.

weight.description: Share of the linked scenario's EV the cell counts: value = preValue + weight × linked EV. Use it when only part of the outcomes reach the linked scenario. Left out when 1.

perspective.description: Whose EV the linked scenario holds. same: its attacker is this scenario's attacker, value = preValue + weight × linked EV. opponent: its attacker is this scenario's defender, value = preValue - weight × linked EV (e.g. -(throw damage) - weight × the opponent's throw oki EV). Any other pairing is rejected. Left out when same.

cachedValue.description: The cell's total, recomputed by the site on import and whenever a linked scenario changes; a value given here is only the starting point of that computation. Layer solving and the saved solution use it as the cell's value. Not part of the re-import content hash.

preValue.description: Value gained before entering the referenced scenario, e.g. the combo that leads into it.
